$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: QrCode
whenToUse: Moving something from screen to phone: 2FA setup, a Wi-Fi or app link, a payment or ticket.

whenNotToUse.text: The user is already on the phone

whenNotToUse.instead: a download or a short link in the code

anatomy.description: white with a 4-module quiet zone — in both themes.
one SVG path; error correction by `level` (H when there’s a center `icon`).

do.caption: The same value as text, for people who can’t scan.

dont.caption: A code alone locks out screen-reader users and anyone without a phone at hand.

a11y: It’s an image named by `label` — describe what scanning does, not “QR code”.
Always pair it with the value as text or a link.
Don’t invert it for dark theme — many scanners can’t read light-on-dark.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional mark in the center (a logo or icon, ~20% of the code). Raises `level` to H.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Describe what scanning does, not what it is: "Scan to add Seashell to your authenticator app".

props.name: level
props.description:
Error correction: how much of the code can be damaged or covered and
still scan — L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30%. Higher levels make a
denser code. Forced to H when `icon` is set, since the icon covers modules.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a placeholder of the same size while the value is being fetched.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered edge length including the quiet zone: sm 128px, md 160px (default), lg 200px.

props.name: value
props.description: The text or URL to encode (e.g. an `otpauth://` URI for 2FA setup).
